description: Names wave sessions (ai-plugins-and-skills:wave-workflow). Bash filters first, so pwsh starts only for a wave-workflow prompt.

hooks.command: IFS= read -r -d '' input; case "$input" in *ai-plugins-and-skills:wave-workflow*) printf '%s' "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/wave-session-title.ps1";; esac; exit 0
